# Canvas Game Idea

**Title:** Sky Runner

Control a constantly running character on an HTML canvas. Tap or click to jump over gaps and obstacles while collecting stars. The game ends (lose condition) when the character collides with an obstacle or falls into a gap. Score is based on distance traveled and stars collected.

1: // Sky Runner – minimal canvas game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   // Audio setup
6:   const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
7:   const audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
8:   // Ensure audio context is resumed on user interaction
9:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
10:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', resumeAudio);
11:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', resumeAudio);
12:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
16:     osc.type = 'sine';
17:     osc.connect(gain);
18:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
21:     osc.start();
22:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
23:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
24:   }
25:   function playJumpSound() { playTone(300, 0.15); }
26:   function playStarSound() { playTone(800, 0.12); }
27:   function playGameOverSound() { playTone(100, 0.5); }
28:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
29:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
30:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
31:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
32:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 400;
33: 
34:   // Game constants
35:   const GRAVITY = 0.5;
36:   const JUMP_SPEED = -12;
37:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 30;
38:   const OBSTACLE_WIDTH = 30;
39:   const GAP_WIDTH = 80;
40:   const STAR_SIZE = 12;
41:   const SCROLL_SPEED = 4;
42:   const CLOUD_COUNT = 3;
43: 
44:   // State
45:   let playerY = H - PLAYER_SIZE;
46: 
47:   // clouds array
48:   let clouds = [];
49: 
50:   let playerVY = 0;
51:   let score = 0;
52:   let stars = 0;
53:   let obstacleX = W;
54:   let isGap = false;
55:   let gapX = W + 200;
56:   let starX = W + 400;
57:   let starY = H - PLAYER_SIZE - 80;
58:   let gameOver = false;
59: 
60:   // Input – tap/click to jump
61:   const jump = () => {
62:     if (playerY >= H - PLAYER_SIZE) {
63:       playerVY = JUMP_SPEED;
64:       playJumpSound();
65:     }
66:   };
67:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', jump);
68:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', jump);
69: 
70:   function reset() {
71:     playerY = H - PLAYER_SIZE;
72:     playerVY = 0;
73:     score = 0;
74:     stars = 0;
75:     obstacleX = W;
76:     isGap = false;
77:     gapX = W + 200;
78:     starX = W + 400;
79:     gameOver = false;
80:     // initialise clouds
81:     clouds = [];
82:     for (let i = 0; i < CLOUD_COUNT; i++) {
83:       clouds.push({
84:         x: Math.random() * W,
85:         y: Math.random() * (H * 0.4),
86:         r: 20 + Math.random() * 15,
87:         speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
88:       });
89:     }
90:   }
91: 
92:   function update() {
93:     if (gameOver) return;
94:     // Move objects left
95:     obstacleX -= SCROLL_SPEED;
96:     gapX -= SCROLL_SPEED;
97:     starX -= SCROLL_SPEED;
98: 
99:     // Move clouds left (parallax slower)
100:     clouds.forEach(c => {
101:       c.x -= c.speed;
102:       if (c.x < -c.r * 2) {
103:         c.x = W + c.r * 2;
104:         c.y = Math.random() * (H * 0.4);
105:         c.r = 20 + Math.random() * 15;
106:         c.speed = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5;
107:       }
108:     });
109: 
110:     // Recycle obstacle
111:     if (obstacleX < -OBSTACLE_WIDTH) {
112:       obstacleX = W + Math.random() * 200;
113:       // Randomly decide if next segment is a gap instead of an obstacle
114:       isGap = Math.random() < 0.3;
115:       if (isGap) gapX = obstacleX + OBSTACLE_WIDTH + GAP_WIDTH;
116:     }
117: 
118:     // Recycle star
119:     if (starX < -STAR_SIZE) {
120:       starX = W + Math.random() * 300;
121:       starY = H - PLAYER_SIZE - 40 - Math.random() * 80;
122:     }
123: 
124:     // Player physics
125:     playerVY += GRAVITY;
126:     playerY += playerVY;
127:     if (playerY > H - PLAYER_SIZE) playerY = H - PLAYER_SIZE;
128: 
129:     // Collision detection with obstacle (if not a gap)
130:     if (!isGap) {
131:       const inX = obstacleX < PLAYER_SIZE && obstacleX + OBSTACLE_WIDTH > 0;
132:       const inY = playerY + PLAYER_SIZE > H - OBSTACLE_WIDTH; // ground obstacle height same as width
133:       if (inX && inY) { gameOver = true; playGameOverSound(); }
134:     }
135: 
136:     // Falling into a gap
137:     if (isGap) {
138:       const overGap = obstacleX < PLAYER_SIZE && obstacleX + OBSTACLE_WIDTH + GAP_WIDTH > 0;
139:       if (overGap && playerY + PLAYER_SIZE >= H) { gameOver = true; playGameOverSound(); }
140:     }
141: 
142:     // Collect star
143:     const starHit = Math.abs(starX - PLAYER_SIZE / 2) < (STAR_SIZE + PLAYER_SIZE) / 2 &&
144:                     Math.abs(starY - playerY) < (STAR_SIZE + PLAYER_SIZE) / 2;
145:     if (starHit) {
146:       stars++;
147:       // Move star out of view
148:       starX = -STAR_SIZE;
149:       playStarSound();
150:     }
151: 
152:     score++;
153:   }
154: 
155:   function draw() {
156:     // Clear
157:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
158: 
159:     // Sky background gradient
160:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
161:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // light sky
162:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4682B4'); // deeper sky
163:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
164:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
165: 
166:     // Clouds
167:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
168:     clouds.forEach(c => {
169:       ctx.beginPath();
170:       ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
171:       ctx.arc(c.x + c.r * 0.8, c.y - c.r * 0.6, c.r * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
172:       ctx.arc(c.x - c.r * 0.8, c.y - c.r * 0.6, c.r * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
173:       ctx.fill();
174:     });
175: 
176:     // Ground
177:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
178:     ctx.fillRect(0, H - 10, W, 10);
179: 
180:     // Player with gradient
181:     ctx.fillStyle = playerColorGrad;
182:     ctx.fillRect(playerX, playerY, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE);
183: 
184:     // Obstacle / gap
185:     ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
186:     if (!isGap) {
187:       ctx.fillRect(obstacleX, H - OBSTACLE_WIDTH - 10, OBSTACLE_WIDTH, OBSTACLE_WIDTH);
188:     } else {
189:       // draw left obstacle block
190:       ctx.fillRect(obstacleX, H - OBSTACLE_WIDTH - 10, OBSTACLE_WIDTH, OBSTACLE_WIDTH);
191:       // draw right obstacle block after gap
192:       const rightX = obstacleX + OBSTACLE_WIDTH + GAP_WIDTH;
193:       ctx.fillRect(rightX, H - OBSTACLE_WIDTH - 10, OBSTACLE_WIDTH, OBSTACLE_WIDTH);
194:     }
195: 
196:     // Star with twinkle effect
197:     ctx.save();
198:     const starAlpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 500);
199:     ctx.globalAlpha = starAlpha;
200:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
201:     ctx.beginPath();
202:     ctx.arc(starX, starY, STAR_SIZE / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
203:     ctx.fill();
204:     ctx.restore();
205: 
206:     // UI
207:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
208:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
209:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
210:     ctx.fillText(`Stars: ${stars}`, 10, 40);
211:     if (gameOver) {
212:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
213:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
214:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
215:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
216:       ctx.fillText('Game Over – Click to Restart', W / 2, H / 2);
217:     }
218:   }
219: 
220:   function loop() {
221:     update();
222:     draw();
223:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
224:   }
225: 
226:   // Restart on click when over
227:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => { if (gameOver) reset(); });
228:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', () => { if (gameOver) reset(); });
229: 
230:   reset();
231:   loop();
232: })();
